procedure.en: Turn the adjustment dial clockwise until it cannot move further. That is the start point. Count rotations, numbers and clicks counter-clockwise from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire o ajuste no sentido horário até não se mover mais. Esse é o ponto inicial. Conte as voltas, os números e os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali.

notes: Rotations.number.click: 30 clicks per rotation, 10 numbers of 3 clicks; about 90 clicks over 3 rotations. 23 µm per click (0.0233 mm) is burr travel quoted by reviewers and a retailer's manual excerpt (iCup), not particle size. Timemore's warning 'do not grind at 0–6 clicks / 0–0.4 circles' is 12 clicks on this ring. All values stored as clicks from zero (1.2.0 = 36).
